displayName: thredUP API - Prices, Estimated Retail, Sold Listings
description: thredUP API for thredUP prices - each item's price, the estimated original retail and the percent off computed from the two, condition and the flaws thredUP noted, measurements, materials and who priced it (thredUP, a Direct Listing peer seller or a dropship partner), from keyword search (119 items per page, up to page 21), sold listings by brand or category (the price the item last listed at; thredUP shows no sold date), category and brand grids and the deal collections (clearance, under $10, new arrivals, price drops) on thredUP's US store (thredup.com, USD). Read one item in full, Rescue boxes with their bundle prices, the categories and filter values, the brand directory, suggestions, trending searches and similar items. 12 endpoints, 1 credit per call. No reviews, seller shops, men's department or price history (poll and store).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
